info.title: Phone API
info.description: Personal Android SMS API over Tailscale. No recipient delivery receipts or automatic SMS retries.

get.summary: Read SMS inbox or a contact conversation

parameters.name: number
parameters.description: E.164 phone number; encode the + as %2B in URLs.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Country for normalising national-format numbers. Defaults to network/SIM country, then device locale, then GB.

parameters.name: box
parameters.description: Defaults to inbox, or all when number is supplied.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Exclusive upper timestamp in milliseconds; must be greater than after.

get.description: Exact E.164 matching after Android number normalisation. Reads SMS only, not MMS/RCS. Bounded newest-first view; timestamp-only paging can skip messages sharing a boundary timestamp.

post.summary: Submit an SMS using the chosen SIM
post.description: Requires Content-Length. Same Idempotency-Key and body never resend. Sent status is not a delivery receipt. Omitting subscriptionId uses the Android default SMS SIM.

409.description: Conflicting idempotency key or missing default SIM

get.summary: Current network and actual IP addresses

parameters.name: number
parameters.description: E.164 phone number; encode the + as %2B in URLs.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Country for normalising national-format numbers. Defaults to network/SIM country, then device locale, then GB.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Unix milliseconds; defaults to seven days after from. Maximum range 31 days.

get.summary: Cached position or an on-demand location fix
get.description: Requires location permission, plus Allow all the time when the app is not visible. No continuous tracking. Cached positions may be stale; inspect ageSeconds. A fresh request may use a recent Android fix or return available:false after timeout. Allow at least 20 seconds client timeout.
Requires special notification access. Own Phone API notifications are excluded. Android may redact sensitive content.

put.description: Disabled by default. Requires a URL to enable. Notification events require an explicit package allowlist. Disabling or changing the URL clears pending events; an in-flight request cannot be recalled. HTTP is allowed only for private-network destinations; use HTTPS publicly. No redirects followed.

409.description: Enable the API and webhooks first

basicAuth.description: Username api; password is the saved API key

token.description: Optional separate Bearer token; empty clears it. Omitted preserves it only for the same URL.
